args.name: facet
args.doc: A filter group of the programme finder: Level, School, Mode, Campus, Fee, Hours.

args.name: value
args.doc: One option of that group as the finder labels it: Postgraduate, Business, Online, Pune, Under ₹1 lakh, Up to 8 hrs a week.

moves.say: {filter: Level | Postgraduate} right before the words that give the reason, one option per cue: "Since you already have a degree, postgraduate."
moves.doc: Tick one option in the programme finder's sidebar: the box is ringed, ticked, and the list narrows. Refused with the group's options when the value is not one of them. Opens /programs first when the finder is not on screen.

args.name: facet
args.doc: The filter group to clear, or nothing for every filter.

moves.say: {clear: Fee} takes the fee filter off; {clear} takes every filter off.
moves.doc: Untick one group's options in the programme finder, or all of them.

args.name: first
args.doc: A programme id from the catalogue, btech-cse.

moves.say: {pick: online-mba | pgd-data-analytics} when you name the two or three programmes that fit; each card is ringed and marked as your pick.
moves.doc: Mark two or three programmes as the advisor's picks: each card is ringed in turn and badged 1, 2, 3, and the shortlist tray shows them. Replaces the previous picks.

moves.say: {compare: online-mba | emba} as you start comparing them; the comparison opens side by side.
moves.doc: Open the side-by-side comparison of two or three programmes: duration, mode, campus, fee per year and in total, hours a week, eligibility, selection, next deadline, scholarships and outcomes.

args.name: program
args.doc: A programme id from the catalogue, mba.

moves.say: {open: mba} when you start talking about one programme's details; its page opens.

args.name: page
args.doc: home, programs, admissions, scholarships, campus-life, apply, schools, or schools/<school id>: schools/law.

moves.say: {go: scholarships} when the conversation moves to another part of the site; that page opens.
moves.doc: Go to a page of the university site.

args.name: target
args.doc: A section of the page in front by its name: fees, eligibility, selection, deadlines, scholarships, outcomes, hostel, loans, documents, ausat, process, faqs, refund, instalments.

moves.say: {show: hostel} as you start talking about that section; it scrolls into view and is ringed.
moves.doc: Scroll to a section of the page in front and ring it. Refused with the sections the page has.

args.name: field
args.doc: A field of the application by its name: full_name, gender, city, state, class12_stream, class12_percent, entrance_exam, program, campus, intake, hostel, room_type, scholarship, doc_class10, pay_method…

args.name: value
args.doc: The value: an option id for a choice (science_pcm, pune, twin_ac, upi), a number for marks (92.4), a programme id for program, a scholarship id for scholarship, uploaded or later for a document, the words said for a text field.

moves.say: {fill: class12_percent | 92.4} at the start of the sentence that says it, one field per cue: "92.4 percent in Class 12, noted."
moves.doc: Set one field of the application as the voice says it: the step opens, the input is ringed and filled. Opens /apply first when the form is not on screen. Refused with the field's options when the value is not one of them.

args.name: step
args.doc: 1 personal details, 2 academics, 3 programme choice, 4 documents, 5 application fee.

moves.say: {step: 3} as you start on that step of the application; it opens and is ringed.
moves.doc: Open a step of the application and ring it.

moves.say: {next} moves the application on to its next step, as Continue does.
moves.doc: Check the step in front as Continue does and open the next one. Refused, naming the required fields still empty.

slices.doc: the programme finder: the filters ticked, how many programmes match, the first ones listed, the advisor's picks and the comparison open

fields.name: top
fields.doc: The ids of the first programmes listed.

fields.name: compared
fields.doc: The ids in the open comparison.

slices.doc: the application form: the step in front, which fields hold something (by name), and the programme, academic and hostel choices

fields.name: filled
fields.doc: Names of the fields that hold something.

fields.name: missing
fields.doc: Required fields of the step in front still empty.

fields.name: reference
fields.doc: The application number, once paid: ANV-27-48213.

events.note: {by} changed the programme finder: {count} programmes match
events.doc: Filters, picks or the comparison changed.
A field of the application was filled or changed.

events.note: {by} is on step {step} of the application
events.doc: The application moved to another step.

events.note: {by} paid the application fee and submitted application {reference}
events.ask: congratulate them in one line, give the application number and say what happens next
events.doc: The applicant pressed Pay and submit.
